outgoing.name: Abraham Lincoln
outgoing.excerpt: His act was the only emancipation of rebellious African Americans prior to the emancipation of the southern slaves by President Abraham Lincoln in 1863.

outgoing.name: Andrew Jackson
outgoing.excerpt: General Andrew Jackson targeted Florida's maroon communities in 1816 by orchestrating an attack on the Negro Fort, a Black Seminole stronghold.

outgoing.name: Slavery
outgoing.excerpt: As early as 1689, African slaves fled from the South Carolina lowcountry to Spanish Florida seeking freedom.

outgoing.name: Mexico
outgoing.excerpt: …staged a mass escape from the Indian Territory to Mexico, where slavery had long been outlawed.

outgoing.name: United States Constitution
outgoing.excerpt: …the first treaty ratified after the adoption of the United States Constitution.
